_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S5 Joovy). Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents the current Joovy Caboose UL; Clek lists 'Caboose Ultralight / Caboose UL' as one entry. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joovy Caboose UL (Caboose Ultralight)

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Caboose Ultralight / Caboose UL — Universal Car Seat Adapter

brake.type: foot-operated parking brake with quick auto-lock fold

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: front seat from ~3 mo or newborn with an infant car seat via adapter; rear standing platform ~2.5 yr+

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness front seat; recycled fabrics; auto-lock fold latch. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification.

specs.strollerType: sit-and-stand tandem double (full-size reclining front seat + rear bench + standing platform; optional rear seat sold separately)

notes: Current-catalog Joovy Caboose UL — one of the lightest tandem sit-and-stand strollers at 26.5 lb (the older Caboose Ultralight it replaces was ~22-23.5 lb; Clek lists both under one row). Ships with an included universal car seat adapter; Clek Liing attaches via the Joovy Universal Car Seat Adapter (adapter-joovy-universal). DTC price $399.90.
